name: Mukhyamantri Kisaan Kalyaan Yojana
briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Kisaan Kalyaan Yojana, launched in 2020 by the Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister, provides financial assistance to farmers.
descriptionMd: The Mukhyamantri Kisaan Kalyaan Yojana was initiated in 2020 by the Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh. This state-level scheme aims to provide crucial financial support to farmers within the state. It is designed to enhance the welfare and economic stability of the agricultural community.
benefitsMd: *   Provides financial assistance to farmers. Contact the official scheme portal for details on specific amounts.
eligibilityMd:
*   Must be a farmer.
*   Resides in Madhya Pradesh.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
